name: Henry Wong
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with [Terriermon], [Gargomon] or [Rapidmon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a green Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
